zone: Area behind the Sisal to Mérida road
change: Die-off due to blocked water flow because of road construction +  Huricanne Gilbert
paraphrase: In northern Yucatán, roads and harbours that block water flow are the main cause of mangrove degradation. The construction of the road from Hunucma to Sisal blocked the water flow and caused the death of this large area. Hurricane Gilbert amplified this die-off. In the past years, part of this area has been restored.

change: Hurricane Gilbert: breaches, seawater intrusion, hypersalinity, mass die-off
recovery: None for ~8 years; bare zones persist today
recovery_mode: Partially naturally, then assisted from 1996 (spring clearing, planting 1997 to 2001)
paraphrase: The hurricane hit Sisal hard and opened many breaches in the coastal strip, letting in a lot of seawater. The water became hypersaline, the mangrove started dying, pests followed, and around 90% died. Patches of dead trees were visible by 1990. He sees the hurricane as the indirect cause; the real damage came from the rise in salinity.
